overtime.settings.qualifiedOvertimeTrack: Starting Jan 1, 2026, the One, Big, Beautiful Bill Act lets employees deduct Fair Labor Standards Act qualified overtime on their federal tax returns. Use the new
pay type to help keep your year-end reporting accurate. Qualified amounts will show on pay stubs and W-2s, but won't change how employee withholdings currently work.
